items.informal_name: Schwartz-Zippel Lemma: Root Bound via Supremum of Exponent Ratios
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        p.support.sup fun s => ∑ i, ↑(s i) / ↑(S i).card
items.informal_description: For any non-zero multivariate polynomial $ p $ in $ n $ variables over a commutative semiring $ R $, and for any finite subsets $ S_i \subseteq R $ for each variable, the ratio of the number of roots of $ p $ in the product set $ S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n $ to the product of the cardinalities $ \prod_{i=1}^n |S_i| $ is at most the supremum over all monomials $ s $ in the support of $ p $ of the sum $ \sum_{i=1}^n \frac{s_i}{|S_i|} $, where $ s_i $ denotes the exponent of the $ i $-th variable in the monomial $ s $. All divisions are performed in the non-negative rational numbers $ \mathbb{Q}_{\geq 0} $.

items.informal_name: Schwartz-Zippel Inequality for Multivariate Polynomials with Sum of Degrees
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        ∑ i, ↑(MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p) / ↑(S i).card
items.informal_description: For a non-zero multivariate polynomial $ p $ in $ n $ variables over a commutative semiring $ R $, and finite sets $ S_i \subseteq R $ for each variable $ i $, the ratio of the number of roots of $ p $ in the Cartesian product $ S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n $ to the product of the sizes $ \prod_{i=1}^n |S_i| $ is at most the sum of the degrees of $ p $ in each variable divided by the corresponding $ |S_i| $. Formally, $$\frac{\#\{x \in S_1 \times \cdots \times S_n \mid p(x) = 0\}}{\prod_{i=1}^n |S_i|} \leq \sum_{i=1}^n \frac{\deg_i(p)}{|S_i|},$$ where $ \deg_i(p) $ denotes the total degree of $ p $ in variable $ i $.

items.informal_description: For natural numbers $k_0, k$, a function $D : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and any $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the degree bound for $n+1$ satisfies: $$\text{degBound}(k_0, \text{casesOn}(t, k, D), n+1) = (k_0 k)^{k_0 k} \cdot \text{degBound}(k_0 k, ((k_0 k)^{k_0 k} \bullet D), n),$$ where $\bullet$ denotes function scaling. This establishes a recursive relationship for degree bounds in multivariate polynomial constructions used in Chevalley's theorem.

items.name: Polynomial.sum_over_range
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) {f : ℕ → R → S},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), f n 0 = 0) → p.sum f = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), f a (p.coeff a)

items.name: Polynomial.sum_fin
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → ∀ {n : ℕ} {p : Polynomial R}, p.degree < ↑n → ∑ i, f (↑i) (p.coeff ↑i) = p.sum f

items.informal_name: Supremum Inequality for Pointwise Addition in Extended Reals
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} {u v : α → EReal}, ⨆ x, (u + v) x ≤ (⨆ x, u x) + ⨆ x, v x
items.informal_description: For any functions $ u $ and $ v $ from an index set $ \iota $ to the extended real numbers $ \overline{\mathbb{R}} $, the supremum of the pointwise sum $ u(x) + v(x) $ over all $ x \in \iota $ is less than or equal to the sum of the suprema of $ u(x) $ and $ v(x) $. Symbolically, $ \sup_{x} (u(x) + v(x)) \leq \sup_{x} u(x) + \sup_{x} v(x) $.

items.informal_name: Supremum Additivity in Extended Non-Negative Reals under Compatibility Condition
items.type: ∀ {ι : Sort u_1} {f g : ι → ENNReal}, (∀ (i j : ι), ∃ k, f i + g j ≤ f k + g k) → iSup f + iSup g = ⨆ i, f i + g i
items.informal_description: For any functions $ f, g : \iota \to [0, \infty] $, if for all $ i, j \in \iota $, there exists a $ k \in \iota $ such that $ f(i) + g(j) \leq f(k) + g(k) $, then $ \sup_i f(i) + \sup_i g(i) = \sup_i (f(i) + g(i)) $.

items.informal_name: Supremum of Minkowski Sum Equals Sum of Suprema
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice M] [inst_1 : AddGroup M] [AddLeftMono M] [AddRightMono M]
  {s t : Set M}, s.Nonempty → BddAbove s → t.Nonempty → BddAbove t → sSup (s + t) = sSup s + sSup t
items.informal_description: In a conditionally complete lattice $M$ equipped with an additive group structure and monotonic addition, for any non-empty bounded above subsets $s$ and $t$ of $M$, the supremum of their Minkowski sum $s + t$ satisfies $\sup(s + t) = \sup(s) + \sup(t)$.

items.informal_name: Addition Distributes Over Supremum in Extended Non-Negative Reals
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ENNReal} {a : ENNReal}, s.Nonempty → a + sSup s = ⨆ b ∈ s, a + b
items.informal_description: For any non-empty set $ s $ in the extended non-negative real numbers $ [0, \infty] $ and for any $ a \in [0, \infty] $, the sum $ a + \sup s $ is equal to the supremum of the set $ \{ a + b \mid b \in s \} $.

items.informal_name: Supremum Additivity in Extended Non-Negative Reals: $\sup s + a = \sup_{b \in s} (b + a)$
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ENNReal} {a : ENNReal}, s.Nonempty → sSup s + a = ⨆ b ∈ s, b + a
items.informal_description: For any non-empty set $ s $ in the extended non-negative real numbers $[0, \infty]$, and for any $ a \in [0, \infty] $, the supremum of $ s $ plus $ a $ is equal to the supremum of the set $ \{ b + a \mid b \in s \} $. In symbols, $ \sup s + a = \sup_{b \in s} (b + a) $.

items.informal_name: Supremum of Minkowski Sum Equals Sum of Suprema
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CompleteLattice M] [inst_1 : AddGroup M] [AddLeftMono M] [AddRightMono M] (s t : Set M),
  sSup (s + t) = sSup s + sSup t
items.informal_description: In a complete lattice that is also an additive group with order-preserving addition, for any subsets $ s $ and $ t $, the supremum of their Minkowski sum $ s + t $ (defined as $ \{s' + t' \mid s' \in s, t' \in t\} $) satisfies $ \sup(s + t) = \sup(s) + \sup(t) $.

items.informal_name: Supremum of Sum is Bounded by Sum of Suprema in Conditionally Complete Lattices
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_2} [Nonempty ι] [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [inst_1 : Add α] [AddLeftMono α]
  [AddRightMono α] {f g : ι → α},
  BddAbove (Set.range f) → BddAbove (Set.range g) → ⨆ i, f i + g i ≤ (⨆ i, f i) + ⨆ i, g i
items.informal_description: In a conditionally complete lattice $\alpha$ equipped with addition and monotonic addition operations, if the ranges of functions $f$ and $g$ from an index type $\iota$ to $\alpha$ are both bounded above, then the supremum of the pointwise sum $f(i) + g(i)$ over all indices $i$ is less than or equal to the sum of the suprema of $f$ and $g$. Formally, $\sup_{i} (f(i) + g(i)) \leq \left(\sup_{i} f(i)\right) + \left(\sup_{i} g(i)\right)$.

items.informal_name: Addition Distributes Over Supremum in Extended Non-Negative Reals
items.type:
∀ {ι : Sort u_1} {a : ENNReal} {p : ι → Prop},
  (∃ i, p i) → ∀ (f : ι → ENNReal), (⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : p i), f i) + a = ⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : p i), f i + a
items.informal_description: For any non-empty family of extended non-negative real numbers $\{f_i\}$ indexed by $i$ satisfying condition $p(i)$, and for any $a \in [0, \infty]$, the supremum of the family plus $a$ equals the supremum of the family elements each added to $a$. Formally, $\left(\bigvee_{i} \bigvee_{p(i)} f_i\right) + a = \bigvee_{i} \bigvee_{p(i)} (f_i + a)$.
